sql_templates.purpose: Fetch latest insider alerts and bulk deals with technical confirmation.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_stage_snapshots AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, trading_signal, snapshot_date
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
),
latest_bulk_deals AS (
    SELECT symbol, price, deal_date
    FROM signals.bulk_block_deals
    WHERE deal_date = (SELECT MAX(deal_date) FROM signals.bulk_block_deals)
),
latest_insider_alerts AS (
    SELECT symbol, alert_date, insider_score
    FROM signals.insider_alerts
    WHERE alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts)
)
SELECT 
    a.symbol, 
    a.alert_date, 
    i.insider_score, 
    b.price AS bulk_deal_price, 
    b.deal_date,
    s.stage, 
    s.trading_signal
FROM latest_stage_snapshots s
JOIN latest_bulk_deals b ON b.symbol = s.symbol
JOIN latest_insider_alerts i ON i.symbol = s.symbol
LIMIT 10;

sql_templates.description: Retrieve latest run analysis with stock and stage details.

    SELECT * 
    FROM report.enhanced_runs 
    WHERE run_ts = (SELECT MAX(run_ts) FROM report.enhanced_runs)
